description: Browse and manage partner organizations with comprehensive search, filtering, and CRUD operations. Central hub for all partner-related activities.

pages.name: PartnerComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for managing all partner organizations. Users can browse, search, filter, create, edit, and delete partner records. It provides an overview of all partners in the system and allows for bulk operations like import and export.

buttons.label: New Partner | Edit Partner
buttons.description: Opens a dialog to create a new partner organization or modify an existing one. This includes comprehensive form fields for managing all aspects of partner information.
when_to_use: When you need to add a brand new partner organization to the system.
When you need to update the core details of an existing partner, such as their name, type, or primary contact information.

buttons.label: Import Partners
buttons.description: Initiates the process to bulk import partner organizations from external data sources like Google Sheets or CSV files.
when_to_use: When you have a large list of partners to add to the system simultaneously.
During initial system setup or data migration from another system.
When receiving partner data from an external source in a structured file format.

tabs.name: Details
tabs.label: title.details
tabs.description: Displays the primary organizational and general information about the partner, such as name, type, status, and office ID.

tabs.name: Contacts
tabs.label: title.contacts
tabs.description: Lists all associated contact persons and their details for this partner, allowing users to manage individual contacts.

tabs.name: Interactions
tabs.label: title.interactions
tabs.description: Shows a chronological record of all communications, meetings, and activities related to this partner, providing a history of engagement.

tabs.name: Data
tabs.label: title.data
tabs.description: Contains additional data, documents, or specific configurations related to the partner, such as agreements or financial information.

search.placeholder: Search partners by name, type, or ID...
search.description: Allows users to quickly find specific partner organizations using keywords, names, types, or unique identifiers across all partner records.
search.help_text: Enter full or partial names, partner types (e.g., 'Vendor', 'Client'), or specific IDs to narrow down results. Search is case-insensitive and applies across multiple fields.

help_guidance.when_stuck: Use the search bar to find specific partners by name, type, or location. Click the 'New Partner' button to create new partners if you have permissions. Use filters (if available) to narrow down results by partner type, status, or organizational unit.
common_tasks: Finding a partner: Use the global search bar or entity-specific filters.
Creating a partner: Click 'New Partner' button (requires appropriate permissions).
Editing a partner: Click on any partner row in the list to open its details, then click the 'Edit Partner' button.
Filtering partners: Use the advanced search and filter options in the left panel (if available) to refine your list.
Exporting data: Use the 'Export' button (if available) to download partner lists in Excel format.
Importing partners: Use the 'Import Partners' button to bulk upload partner data from a file.

pages.name: PartnerViewComponent
pages.description: This page provides a detailed view of a single partner organization. It allows users to view and edit comprehensive partner information, including contact details, address, organizational data, and associated documents. It serves as the central place for managing all aspects of a specific partner.

buttons.label: Edit Partner
buttons.description: Opens the partner editing dialog, allowing users to modify various fields of the current partner organization's information.
when_to_use: When any information about the partner needs to be updated or corrected.
When adding new organizational details, contact information, or other relevant data to the partner's profile.

search.description: This page is designed for viewing and editing a single partner's details and does not include a search function for other partners.

help_guidance.when_stuck: This page shows complete partner information. Click 'Edit Partner' to modify details, use the tabs to navigate between different sections (e.g., Contacts, Interactions), or click the logo area to upload a new partner logo. All fields are organized by category for easy access.
common_tasks: Editing partner info: Click the 'Edit Partner' button and modify the relevant form fields.
Uploading logo: Click on the logo/image area (if available) to upload a new partner logo.
Viewing contacts: Navigate to the 'Contacts' tab to see people associated with this partner.
Adding interactions: Go to the 'Interactions' tab and click 'Add Interaction' (if available).
Managing documents: Scroll down to the 'Documents' section (if available) to upload or view files.
Updating address: Edit the address fields within the 'Contact Information' section (if available).
